main_body: brick kitchen range with metal range hood, cooktop surface, and firebox
top_band: trapezoidal metal hood slope (rows 21-25) and foreshortened metal cooktop with two burner grates (rows 28-34)
evidence: The range shows a clear 3/4 view: a brick chimney (rows 8-20) has a protruding trapezoidal metal hood (rows 21-26) with a 1px top highlight and dark front lip/eave shadow (rows 26-27), overhanging a foreshortened horizontal cooktop surface (rows 28-34, 7 rows tall) with two grates and a bright 1px front edge at row 34, followed by an eave shadow at row 35 and the vertical brick front face (rows 36-47, 12 rows tall) containing an inset firebox.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference stall and well, the candidate uses flat unshaded rectangular blocks for the bricks (2 tones: flat grey-purple fill and dark mortar) and a large flat fill on the metal hood (rows 22-25 are almost a single flat dark slate colour). Heavy pure-black outlines wrap the hood and firebox, giving it a simpler, flatter look than the richly textured references.
